# Framework Self-Review Checklist

Use this checklist when changing the framework itself.

## Before merging

- Confirm the change still reads as framework-agnostic.
- Confirm the change improves reuse, clarity, or safety.
- Confirm the change does not introduce hidden stack assumptions.
- Confirm the change fits the repo's charter split and governance model.

## After merging

- Verify the updated docs are reflected in `REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md` if needed.
- Verify the change is discoverable from `AGENTS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` if needed.
- Record any meaningful decision or lesson in repository memory.

## Good candidates for this checklist

- Skills
- Governance docs
- Workflow rules
- Setup flow changes
- Repository health helpers
